BTC.note: spot crypto; no dividends. Backfilled 2026-05-23: monthly OHLC for 2010-07 → 2014-08 derived from CoinMetrics community-tier daily PriceUSD (open=first-day, close=last-day, high=max, low=min). Yahoo Finance covers 2014-09 onwards. Splice point validated (2014-08-31 CoinMetrics close $478.51 → 2014-09-01 Yahoo open $465.86, 2.6% day-to-day drop is within normal BTC volatility).
